our_interpretation: Read as a skeptical forecast about noncoders building and operating dependable software with AI coding tools.
Prime time means sustained use by real users, with ordinary reliability and maintenance demands.
A qualifying counterexample must extend beyond a narrowly bounded utility. Its builders' coding background and any engineering assistance must be documented.
The claim sets no deadline. Present failures cannot establish that noncoders will never succeed.
criteria.support_condition: Broad deployment evidence showing persistent inability to operate dependable applications beyond very narrow uses would support the concern, but cannot conclusively establish this deadline-free negative forecast.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Documented sustained deployments beyond very narrow uses, built and maintained by noncoders using AI tools, including successful handling of ordinary integration failures.
